pages.title: Eight States
pages.text: Herobrine responds to your actions, the environment and his memories. His eight states are Observer, Protector, Judge, Prankster, Maintainer, Glitch Lord, Monster King and Reminiscing.$(br2)Check the main panel for his current state. Trust and mental state are separate systems.

pages.title: Living Together
pages.text: Watch his position, gaze, speech and the world around him. Repeated attacks build resentment; danger, anomalies and memories also affect his reactions.$(br2)States change during play. Companion mode has a separate follow toggle on the main panel. See $(l:herobrine_companion:commands/commands_overview)Companion Commands$(/l) to change states manually.
